verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented Developer API. Its getting-started guide covers creating an app and access token. It uses OAuth 2.0 with client-credentials and authorization-code flows and granular resource:permission scopes. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, and endpoint guides cover transactions, bills, virtual cards via the Vault API, custom records and AI usage. A sandbox API base and machine-readable llms.txt and llms-api exports round out agent-friendly consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real API calls (especially writes) beyond the schema probe; some sensitive endpoints such as the Vault API require Ramp approval.
